# Whale length in feet
whale_length_feet = 200

# Remora details
num_remoras = 2
remora_length_inches = 12

# Convert remora length to feet (12 inches = 1 foot)
remora_length_feet = (num_remoras * remora_length_inches) / 12

# Calculate total length of remoras
total_remora_length = remora_length_feet

# Calculate percentage
percentage = (total_remora_length / whale_length_feet) * 100

print(percentage)
